label: Bible Study
prompt: And he taught, saying unto them, Is it not written, My house shall be called of all nations the house of prayer? but ye have made it a den of _____.
verse: And he taught, saying unto them, Is it not written, My house shall be called of all nations the house of prayer? but ye have made it a den of thieves.
note: Jesus clearing the temple — quoting Isaiah 56 and Jeremiah 7 as he did it.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And this is the promise that he hath promised us, even eternal _____.
verse: And this is the promise that he hath promised us, even eternal life.
note: The promise in one phrase: eternal life — and the One who promised it keeps His word.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And I will shoot three _____ on the side thereof, as though I shot at a mark.
verse: And I will shoot three arrows on the side thereof, as though I shot at a mark.
note: Jonathan's secret signal for David hiding in the field: where the arrows landed would tell him whether to run.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Let no man deceive you by any means: for that day shall not come, except there come a falling away first, and that man of sin be revealed, the son of _____;
verse: Let no man deceive you by any means: for that day shall not come, except there come a falling away first, and that man of sin be revealed, the son of perdition;
note: The Thessalonians feared they'd missed the day; Paul says a falling away and the man of sin come first.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: From the sole of the foot even unto the head there is no soundness in it; but wounds, and bruises, and _____ sores: they have not been closed, neither bound up, neither mollified with ointment.
verse: From the sole of the foot even unto the head there is no soundness in it; but wounds, and bruises, and putrifying sores: they have not been closed, neither bound up, neither mollified with ointment.
note: Isaiah's diagnosis of a sinful nation: wounds, bruises, and 'putrifying sores' — note the KJV spelling — with no one to bind them.
